svg.title: ME3 detailed architecture
svg.desc: Pi-local voice, context, Onit, guarded MCP tools and Piper, with separate cloud recognition, reasoning and external services. Architecture aligned with the two-page summary and expanded script.
svg.text: Standalone Raspberry Pi 5 runtime with Wi-Fi | Voice, text, shared context and guarded task execution
CLOUD SERVICES — model inference and authorized external access
RASPBERRY PI 5 — local services, conversation ownership and execution control
ME3 GUI: microphone start/stop · text input · conversation / Copy conversation · status notices · Artifacts preview
Recognition model runs outside the Pi
Separate roles; Qwen cannot authorize actions
WebRTC AEC and turn / pause handling
One conversation owner for voice AND typed input
Bounded history · goal ID / revision · clarification
Tool evidence · pending review · retained replies
Persistent artifacts are read through tools
Interprets the goal using the selected language model
Chooses supplied tools and prepares responses
Provider broker checks admission / counts requests
No model-generated expansion of host permissions
Validate permitted action and current identity
Actual tool schemas and scoped access
Complete reply or validated earlier speech prefix
Spoken-text preparation and coherent phrase groups
A progress cue is not proof of task completion
Duplex control — host-owned, not a second planner
Acknowledgment: suspend / resume the SAME answer
Correction: invalidate stale generation; replace reply
Generation + request IDs fence obsolete results
Tool-free Qwen advisory supports floor decisions
Host validates; advisory cannot authorize actions
Saved files / apps and current file versions
Preview opens inside the ME3 GUI
No automatic resend of uncertain effects
Dotted return: mixer output reference → AEC
“Student-built” means the MCP service and integration were implemented for the assignment; the speech models were reused.
Cloud calls require Wi-Fi and private provider/account setup. The normal Pi runtime does not require the laptop or Codex desktop.
Floor advisory: qwen/qwen3.8-27b, tool-free. Startup prewarming remains inactive. External actions remain guarded and independently verified.
Audio, text, model and tool data; two arrowheads indicate exchange
Duplex control: activity, ownership, pause / resume and cancellation
State / verification records or audio echo reference
Aligned with the two-page summary and expanded script · Pi source 03d7a144… · Architecture diagram, not a claim that every case passed.
